greeting.speaker: SCIENTIST
greeting.text: Good morning, little cosmonaut. Ready for our game?

greeting.speaker: SCIENTIST
greeting.text: Find two batteries and bring them to the low training stand. One at a time. Follow your nose!

reminder.speaker: SCIENTIST
reminder.text: Two batteries, little one. Pick one up with your teeth, then click the stand to put it in.

scientist.speaker: SCIENTIST
scientist.text: There you are. Best colleague I've ever had. Very few complaints.

trained.speaker: SCIENTIST
trained.text: Perfect! All systems ready. You are a very good employee.

trained.speaker: SCIENTIST
trained.text: Now into your capsule. Get comfortable, Laika. I'll be listening.

arrival.speaker: STATION AUTOMATION
arrival.text: Unscheduled arrival. Please identify the responsible operator.

arrival.speaker: STATION AUTOMATION
arrival.text: Voice accepted. Welcome, Chief Engineer. All outstanding faults are now your responsibility.

robot.speaker: ROBOT
robot.text: At last. Someone qualified. My previous supervisor never brought me anything in their mouth.

robot.speaker: ROBOT
robot.text: The transmitter needs repairs. This is where the current playground ends.
